capabilities: translate selected text via DeepL API
replace the selection with its translation
append the translation after the selection
pick source and target languages from a suggestion modal
configure default source and target languages in settings
extras: Not an official DeepL plugin; all selected text is sent to DeepL, so the README directs users to review DeepL's privacy policy before use.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to translate selected text without leaving the editor or using an external tool.

relations.evidence: Translate your texts with DeepL in Obsidian.

summary: Translation plugin that translates selected text to over 25 languages via the DeepL API, replacing or appending the result.
